in_hebrew.name: Haugen
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Hill or mountain dweller
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Haugen הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old Norse 'haugr', meaning 'hill' or 'mountain'. This name was common among the Norse people, who lived in rugged, mountainous regions.

in_greek.name: Αυγέν
in_greek.long_meaning: Originating from a good or well-born family

in_latin.name: Haugen
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Hill or mountain dweller
in_latin.long_meaning: Haugen est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from Old Norse 'haugr', meaning 'hill' or 'mountain'. This name was common among the Norse people, who lived in rugged, mountainous regions.
